end.summary:
Read and wrote 4-digit numbers in words and numerals; 1 unaided correct out of 2 attempts.
Practised thousands, hundreds, tens and ones; 1 unaided correct out of 2 attempts.
Confused a digit’s face value with its place value, especially 1 in 8614 and 3 in 3456.
Later distinguished 3500 from 3050 using place value.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading and writing 4-digit numbers and breaking them into thousands, hundreds, tens and ones. Diya used the place positions to distinguish 3500 from 3050, but mixed up the value of 1 in the tens place in 8614; this was not corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, practise with a place-value chart by asking, “What is the value of this digit in this number?”
